title: Elderly Woman Holding Flowers, 1947 B&W Porch Snapshot Photo
description: A clear, charming mid-century black and white snapshot taken in June 1947 featuring an elderly woman standing outside her brick porch while holding a small bouquet of white flowers. She wears round wire-rimmed spectacles and a floral printed dress with a white collar, classic fashion of post-WWII America. The photo features decorative deckle-edges, characteristic of photographic prints from the late 1940s.
